lore.bio:
Almost a century ago, the Outlands were dangling on the edge of a cataclysmic energy crisis. Dr. Mary Somers, a charmingly eccentric astrophysicist, was hired to find a solution. Mary moved her family to the scientific research station on Olympus and set to work. With the help of her apprentice, Dr. Reid, Mary discovered Branthium - an element she was convinced could be the key to limitless energy. But Branthium can be found only on the accretion disk of a black hole, so Mary and Dr. Reid departed on a dangerous mission to prove her theory right.
Mary promised her son Newton she’d return safe and sound. But Dr. Reid betrayed her, stealing the Branthium and sending her shuttle into the black hole’s orbit. Using her wits, Mary modified her robotic vacuum companion N.E.W.T. to escape. But time moves differently on the outskirts of a black hole, and she was 87 years too late.
From that day on, she had one goal: to find a way to get back to her son. She joined the Apex Games as Horizon, master of gravity, to fund her research on time distortion and fluctuation. Her first foray into the Games was on Olympus, where her old life once was and where she had promised to return. That wasn't the only part of her old life that found her again - a certain research assistant, older and now much more metallic, has darkened Dr. Somers' door.

For more information on Horizon's story, see Horizon (character).

passive.name: Spacewalk
passive.description: Increase air control and reduce fall impacts with Horizon’s custom spacesuit.

tactical.name: Gravity Lift
tactical.description: Reverses the flow of gravity, lifting players upward at an increased speed but for a reduced duration. Using a zipline after a Gravity Lift will no longer increase accuracy. Visual effects have been adjusted to reduce visual load on the battlefield and audio has been made more noticeable.

ultimate.name: Black Hole
ultimate.description: Deploy N.E.W.T. to create a micro black hole that pulls players in towards it, dealing damage and with a radius.

details: [Passive] Buff -> Gravity Lift: increased lift speed, increased hover time at top of lift, cooldown reductions.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Black Hole: reduced cooldown by 30 seconds, increased health.

[Perks] Adjust -> Upgrades: Level 2 - Gravity Boots: Press crouch while in the air to fall much more quickly, Newt Scoot: Press jump after exiting gravity lift to glide; Level 3 - Knock Expert: gain tactical charge on knocks.
[Base] Buff -> Gravity Lift: adjusted visual effects of the lift to reduce visual load on the battlefield.
[Base] Buff -> Gravity Lift: adjusted audio of players in the lift to be more noticeable.
[Perks] Adjust -> Battpack : in addition to the extra battery per stack, this upgrade now also shows battery counts in Death Boxes
[Tactical] Nerf -> Black Hole: reduced damage and radius.
[Ultimate] Adjust -> Gravity Lift: increased lift speed but reduced lift duration.
[Passive] Nerf -> Gravity Lift : reduced lift duration.
[Tactical] Buff -> Black Hole : increased damage.
[Perks] Adjust -> Gravity Lift : increased lift range.
[Black Hole] Nerf -> Increased cooldown from 2 minutes to 3 minutes.
[Gravity Lift] Fix -> Fixed the Gravity Lift falling through the floor when used on the train tracks in Sorting Factory on World's Edge.
[Gravity Lift] Buff -> Using a zipline after a Gravity Lift will no longer increase accuracy.
[Finisher animation] Buff -> The All Charged Up finisher now has more frames, from 141 (4.21 seconds) to 180 (6.0 seconds), to be more in line with other finishers’ completion times.
[Gravity Lift] Buff -> Increased effective cooldown from 21 seconds to 25 seconds.
[Abilities destroyed by Wattson's Interception Pylon] Fix -> Horizon's abilities no longer get destroyed by Wattson’s Interception Pylon.
Gravity Lift: Increased effective cooldown from 16 seconds to 21 seconds. (The 15-second cooldown began 5 seconds later.)
Black Hole: Cooldown now starts when N.E.W.T. disappears.
Fixed an issue with Horizon’s abilities not affecting Lifeline’s DOC and Crypto’s drone.
Introduced.
